QuestInfo.name: [Missing Santa] Bicho's snowman
QuestInfo.0: Bicho in Happyville looks too weak to make a snowman all by himself, but he is doing quite well so far. But it seems like he is looking for someone.
QuestInfo.1: Bicho asked you to find the person who helped him make the snowman. He said that the person is somewhere in Maple World.\n\nHis friend's name is #b#X4490##k
QuestInfo.2: Due to Bicho's misunderstanding, you were not able to find the Mapler who had helped him earlier. Wait, Bicho is thinking of another name now? You should go visit him!

info.0: You couldn't find the Mapler yet? I will tell you once again. The name of the Mapler is #b#X4490##k . Don't forget this time!
